entries.zh: 送年：岁末年初馈赠的年礼，贺年所送之礼
entries.en: New Year's gift; a present given at the turn of the year
entries.notes: L 栏「presente es seda passado el año」扞格难通，疑「es seda」为「se da」之讹（或可读作「以丝绸为礼」），故取年礼义。

entries.zh: 送风：为远行者送行所赠之礼，寓一路顺风之意
entries.en: send-off gift for a traveller; a farewell present wishing fair winds
entries.notes: L「presente pel camino」谓途中之礼；H「送风」按字面取祝顺风之送行礼义，属推断。

entries.zh: 送别：送行时赠送的离别礼物
entries.en: farewell present; parting gift

entries.zh: 贽仪（原稿录作「赞仪」）：初次谒见尊长时所奉的见面礼
entries.en: introductory gift offered on a formal visit; ceremonial present of courtesy
entries.notes: H 录作「赞仪」，M 读 chy-sy 与「贽仪」相合（贽即初见之礼），据音订字。

entries.zh: 贽见礼（原稿录作「赞见礼」）：谒见上官时所备的贽敬之礼
entries.en: gift of introduction presented when paying a formal visit to a superior
entries.notes: H 作「赞见礼」，M chy-quien-ley 指向「贽见礼」，据音订字；L 云「拜访之礼」。

entries.zh: 折仪：以银钱折代礼物的馈礼、贺仪
entries.en: cash in lieu of a ceremonial gift; a present commuted into money

entries.zh: 投降：向主上投诚归附，自请约束
entries.en: to surrender; to submit oneself to a lord
entries.notes: L 栏文字残损（sy.ºra、obligalle），仅可读为「向主上自投、受其约束」，义据 H、M 定。

entries.zh: 茶巢：致送官员的茶礼（茶具或茶品一类），词义待考
entries.en: tea present for a mandarin (uncertain; literally 'tea nest')
entries.notes: H「茶巢」非经见成词，M te-ue 音近「茶会」，L 仅云「送官之礼」，三者不能互证。

entries.zh: 人事：馈赠的礼物、人情；亦指人间事务
entries.en: a gift or present; human affairs
entries.notes: 明代「人事」有馈礼义，与 L 的 presente 相合；L 后半「sabia」不可解，故降为中等。

entries.zh: 贺仪：道喜时致送的贺礼，多为银钱
entries.en: congratulatory gift (usually money) offered with good wishes

entries.zh: 贺礼：庆贺时所送的礼物
entries.en: congratulatory present

entries.zh: 前：面前、跟前；在……之前
entries.en: before; in front of (in the presence of)

entries.zh: 现：现在的、眼前的；显现
entries.en: present, current; to appear

entries.zh: 前：跟前、当面，即「在……面前」
entries.en: before; in the presence of

entries.zh: 面前：当面、跟前面
entries.en: in front of one; face to face

entries.zh: 对面会：当面相见、面对面会晤
entries.en: to meet face to face; a face-to-face meeting
entries.notes: 「对面会」非经见成词，依 H、M 字面释为当面相见。

entries.zh: 临时：当时、暂时；即时而办
entries.en: at the time; temporary, improvised

entries.zh: 浅近：浅显易懂；亦指浅近、不远
entries.en: plain and simple; near at hand
entries.notes: L「presente cosa」与 H「浅近」对应不明，或编者以「眼前浅近」为释，义难定夺。

entries.zh: 投到：到官府投呈报到，应召唤而前往听候
entries.en: to report one's arrival; to present oneself before a mandarin

entries.zh: 状（疑为「状元」之略）：西语作「议事会主席」，恐系编者对中国科名的比附
entries.en: zhuang (prob. abbreviation of zhuangyuan); rendered by the compilers as 'president of the council'
entries.notes: H 仅一字、M 仅 chong，L 之官职名系编者比附，义不能定。

entries.zh: 状元：殿试第一名；西语以「议事会主席」比附之
entries.en: zhuangyuan, first-place graduate of the palace examination (glossed as 'president of the council')
entries.notes: 「议事会主席」为编者对中国科名的近似比附，非确译。
